evals.prompt: Build a lean brand for a Tucson-based AI automation service helping small professional firms eliminate repetitive admin work. I have no testimonials yet, but I can demonstrate a working workflow.
evals.expected_output: A complete eight-stage lean brand launch brief with truthful process-based proof and deferred polish.

evals.prompt: Run only the minimum visual kit stage for my mobile dog-grooming service for busy Tucson professionals. The brand should feel dependable, warm, and easy to recognize.
evals.expected_output: Only a practical visual kit: colors, Google Fonts pairing, simple logo direction, and a few consistency rules.

evals.prompt: Create the post-launch two-week iteration plan for a one-page consulting site. Visitors are reaching the page but asking what happens after they submit the form.
evals.expected_output: A focused signal-to-improvement plan centered on the observed CTA confusion, without recommending a broad redesign.
